name: std::chrono::operator==(std::chrono::weekday)

declarations.code:
constexpr bool operator==(const std::chrono::weekday &x,

    const std::chrono::weekday &y) noexcept;

intro:
Compare the two std::chrono::weekday x and y.

The != operator is synthesized from operator==.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: weekday does not support the <, <=, > and >= operators because there is no universal consensus on which day is the first day of the week.

summary: Compare the two std::chrono::weekday x and y.
